soru: Uzamsal bağlaşık (spatially coupled) kodlar, iletişim ve veri depolama için kodlama kuramındaki son gelişmeler üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Uzamsal bağlaşık (spatially coupled) kodlar, iletişim ve veri depolama için kodlama kuramındaki son gelişmeler üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2026-04-12. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first), each with its arXiv id and/or DOI. You may search the web.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Threshold Saturation via Spatial Coupling: Why Convolutional LDPC Ensembles Perform So Well over the BEC
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced and proved threshold saturation, the central mechanism behind spatially coupled codes.

calismalar.baslik: Spatially Coupled Ensembles Universally Achieve Capacity Under Belief Propagation
calismalar.gerekce: It proved that SC-LDPC ensembles universally achieve capacity under belief propagation on all binary memoryless symmetric channels.

calismalar.baslik: Time-Varying Periodic Convolutional Codes With Low-Density Parity-Check Matrix
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced LDPC convolutional codes, the historical starting point of spatial coupling.

calismalar.baslik: Iterative Decoding Threshold Analysis for LDPC Convolutional Codes
calismalar.gerekce: It showed that the BP thresholds of terminated LDPC convolutional codes approach the MAP threshold.

calismalar.baslik: A Simple Proof of Maxwell Saturation for Coupled Scalar Recursions
calismalar.gerekce: It gave a simple, general potential-function proof of threshold saturation.

calismalar.baslik: Threshold Saturation for Spatially Coupled LDPC and LDGM Codes on BMS Channels
calismalar.gerekce: It extended the potential-function method to general BMS channels and to LDGM codes.

calismalar.baslik: Statistical-Physics-Based Reconstruction in Compressed Sensing
calismalar.gerekce: It showed that spatial coupling reaches the optimal limit in compressed sensing.

calismalar.baslik: Information-Theoretically Optimal Compressed Sensing via Spatial Coupling and Approximate Message Passing
calismalar.gerekce: It rigorously proved that spatially coupled matrices with AMP achieve the information-theoretic limit.

calismalar.baslik: Spatially Coupled LDPC Codes Constructed From Protographs
calismalar.gerekce: It provided the comprehensive analysis of protograph-based SC-LDPC constructions used in practice.

calismalar.baslik: Spatially Coupled Sparse Codes on Graphs: Theory and Practice
calismalar.gerekce: It is the widely cited survey of SC code theory and practical applications.

calismalar.baslik: Windowed Decoding of Protograph-Based LDPC Convolutional Codes Over Erasure Channels
calismalar.gerekce: It established windowed decoding, the basis of low-latency practical SC decoding.

calismalar.baslik: Wave-Like Solutions of General One-Dimensional Spatially Coupled Systems
calismalar.gerekce: It explained the decoding-wave dynamics of coupled systems in general form.

calismalar.baslik: A Scaling Law to Predict the Finite-Length Performance of Spatially-Coupled LDPC Codes
calismalar.gerekce: It gave the fundamental scaling law that predicts finite-length SC-LDPC performance.

calismalar.baslik: Staircase Codes: FEC for 100 Gb/s OTN
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced staircase codes, the spatially coupled product codes that became a standard in optical communication.

calismalar.baslik: Approaching Capacity at High Rates With Iterative Hard-Decision Decoding
calismalar.gerekce: It showed that spatially coupled generalized LDPC/product codes approach capacity under hard-decision decoding.

calismalar.baslik: Spatially Coupled Soft-Decision Error Correction for Future Lightwave Systems
calismalar.gerekce: It demonstrated the practical design of SC-LDPC codes for high-speed optical communication.

calismalar.baslik: Spatially Coupled Turbo-Like Codes
calismalar.gerekce: It extended spatial coupling to turbo-like codes and proved threshold saturation for them.

calismalar.baslik: Approximate Message-Passing Decoder and Capacity Achieving Sparse Superposition Codes
calismalar.gerekce: It showed that spatially coupled sparse superposition codes achieve capacity with AMP.

calismalar.baslik: Capacity-Achieving Spatially Coupled Sparse Superposition Codes With AMP Decoding
calismalar.gerekce: It rigorously proved that SC-SPARCs achieve capacity on the AWGN channel.

calismalar.baslik: Approaching the Rate-Distortion Limit With Spatial Coupling, Belief Propagation, and Decimation
calismalar.gerekce: It applied spatial coupling to lossy source coding and approached the rate-distortion limit.

calismalar.baslik: Threshold Saturation for Nonbinary SC-LDPC Codes on the Binary Erasure Channel
calismalar.gerekce: It generalized threshold saturation to nonbinary SC-LDPC codes.

calismalar.baslik: Performance Improvement of Iterative Multiuser Detection for Large Sparsely Spread CDMA Systems by Spatial Coupling
calismalar.gerekce: It showed that spatial coupling gives optimal detection performance in multiuser communication.

calismalar.baslik: Multiple Access Demodulation in the Lifted Signal Graph With Spatial Coupling
calismalar.gerekce: It applied spatial coupling to the multiple access channel.

calismalar.baslik: Finite-Length Construction of High Performance Spatially-Coupled Codes via Optimized Partitioning and Lifting
calismalar.gerekce: It gave the OO-CPO finite-length SC code design framework for data storage.

calismalar.baslik: A Generalized Algebraic Approach to Optimizing SC-LDPC Codes
calismalar.gerekce: It provided an algebraic edge-spreading optimization that minimizes harmful substructures such as trapping sets.

calismalar.baslik: Breaking the Computational Bottleneck: Probabilistic Optimization of High-Memory Spatially-Coupled Codes
calismalar.gerekce: It brought a probabilistic approach to the open problem of designing high-memory SC codes.

calismalar.baslik: Spatially-Coupled LDPC Codes With Sub-Block Locality
calismalar.gerekce: It added local access/decoding to SC-LDPC codes for data storage.

calismalar.baslik: Threshold Saturation in Spatially Coupled Constraint Satisfaction Problems
calismalar.gerekce: It showed that threshold saturation extends beyond coding to constraint satisfaction problems.

calismalar.baslik: On the Waterfall Performance of Finite-Length SC-LDPC Codes Constructed From Protographs
calismalar.gerekce: It extended the finite-length performance prediction to protograph-based SC-LDPC codes.

calismalar.baslik: Braided Convolutional Codes With Sliding Window Decoding
calismalar.gerekce: It established the sliding-window decoding performance of spatially coupled turbo-type braided codes.
